metadata.provenance: Synthesized summary from OWASP Top 10 2021 public documentation (https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/), not verbatim

owasp_top10_2021.name: Broken Access Control
owasp_top10_2021.description: Access control enforces policy such that users cannot act outside of their intended permissions. Failures lead to unauthorized information disclosure, modification, or destruction of data.
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Test for IDOR/BOLA by changing IDs, test BFLA by accessing admin endpoints with low-privilege user, test CORS, test privilege escalation
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: Deny by default, implement access control checks server-side, disable directory listing, log access failures

owasp_top10_2021.name: Cryptographic Failures
owasp_top10_2021.description: Failures related to cryptography leading to exposure of sensitive data. Focus on data in transit and at rest.
common_vulns: hardcoded secrets (in code, but we check for exposure)
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Check for sensitive data exposure in responses, check TLS config, check for weak hashing, check for sensitive data in logs
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: Encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit, use strong crypto, disable weak ciphers, proper key management

owasp_top10_2021.name: Injection
owasp_top10_2021.description: User-supplied data not validated, filtered, or sanitized. Host can interpret it as command or query.
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Test with witness payloads: XSS <script>alert(1)</script>, SQLi ' OR 1=1, SSTI {{7*7}}, SSRF http://127.0.0.1, XXE <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM 'file:///etc/passwd'>
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: Validate input, parameterized queries, ORM, escape output, least privilege

owasp_top10_2021.name: Insecure Design
owasp_top10_2021.description: Missing or ineffective control design. Shift-left, threat modeling, secure design patterns.
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Threat modeling, review design docs, test business logic flows for bypass
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: Secure design patterns, threat modeling, defense in depth, write user stories with security

owasp_top10_2021.name: Security Misconfiguration
owasp_top10_2021.description: Missing appropriate security hardening, misconfigured permissions, unnecessary features enabled, default accounts.
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Check for exposed config files, check error messages, check default accounts, check unnecessary HTTP methods
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: Hardening, remove unused features, review configs, automated scanning

owasp_top10_2021.name: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
owasp_top10_2021.description: Using components with known vulnerabilities, not scanning, not upgrading.
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Check for outdated components via headers, check JS libraries, use CVE database
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: Inventory components, monitor CVEs, update, use SCA tools

owasp_top10_2021.name: Identification and Authentication Failures
owasp_top10_2021.description: Failures related to authentication, session management.
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Test auth bypass, session management, brute force protection, password policy
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: MFA, strong password policy, secure session management, no default creds

owasp_top10_2021.name: Software and Data Integrity Failures
owasp_top10_2021.description: Code and infrastructure that does not protect against integrity violations, insecure deserialization.
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Check deserialization, check CI/CD pipeline, check for unsigned data
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: Digital signatures, verify integrity, secure deserialization, secure CI/CD

owasp_top10_2021.name: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
owasp_top10_2021.description: Insufficient logging, monitoring, alerting, incident response.
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Check if actions are logged, check for sensitive data in logs, test monitoring
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: Log auth failures, input validation failures, use SIEM, alerting

owasp_top10_2021.name: Server-Side Request Forgery
owasp_top10_2021.description: SSRF flaws occur when web app fetches remote resource without validating user-supplied URL.
owasp_top10_2021.testing_approach: Test with SSRF payloads: http://127.0.0.1, http://169.254.169.254 (cloud metadata, requires approval), http://internal
owasp_top10_2021.remediation: Validate URLs, deny list, disable unnecessary URL schemas, use allow list
